## About Me

Hi, my name is Savera Sethi, and I am a Psychology student at the University of Waterloo. I am interested in clinical psychology and plan to pursue graduate studies in psychotherapy or clinical psychology.

I'm interested in the intersection of data and decision-making, and I enjoy working with tools like R, Python, and Quarto to analyze and communicate findings.


## Research  Interests

My research interests are in complex PTSD and how trauma impacts individuals. I hope to specialize in evidence-based approaches such as Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). Additionally, I am interested in relationships and attachment.
